structure: Part 1, shared layout, copy and journey flow, read at repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend main 4c2119da (tag 0.286.0). Read in full: src/server/app/shared/ (layout.njk, kit.js, copy.js, copy-leaves.js, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, paths.js, set-context.js, save-actions.njk, error-summary.njk, error.njk, section-caption.njk; unit tests left out), src/server/app/routes-live-animals.js, routes.js, set-completeness.js, sets/live-animals/set.js, journeys/linear/config.js, features/index.js, features/evaluation.js, features/system/evaluation.js, flow/flow.js, flow/task-rows.js, flow/run.js, flow/stored-answers.js, flow/entry-guard.js, flow/section-captions/ (index.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js), the section-caption, page-title and service-navigation fit specs, fit/journey-smoke.fit.spec.js, fit/live-animals-journey.js and fit/sign-in.js. Page ids and slugs were looked up in each feature's page.js only to name the flow's pages. Covered: the page shell (title pattern, GOV.UK header, service navigation and its four items, alpha phase banner and feedback link, back link, notification banners for recoverable and stale-action errors, journey status strip, footer links, error page and unauthorised copy); every shared copy string and validator default, with the Welsh files read for existence and parity; the save-actions, error-summary and section-caption components and the shared view-model helpers (change context, exit to hub, date field, recoverable save); the set mount at /live-animals with session auth on every route and the 28 mounted route modules; the ten flow sections and their pages, the review gate, the opening run's 14 steps, the 12 hub task rows with their parts and applicability, stored-answer demotion, the deep-link entry guard; the 8 caption sections and their strings; and every test in the four fit specs. Gaps recorded: no language toggle, a placeholder Manage account link, and no custom skip link.

claims.statement: The answer sections are every flow section except review.

A new notification's opening run takes 'Save and continue' through the whole notification, from the origin page to the review page, without stopping at the overview; the overview is reached only through 'Save and return to overview'.

 * and the hub is somewhere the user chooses to go through the secondary
 * "Save and return to overview" button.

claims.statement: The opening run visits 14 steps in this order: origin, commodity search, consignment details, import reason, animal identification, additional details, port of entry, transit countries, transporters, accompanying documents, addresses, CPH number, consignment contact, review.
